facts.fact: Merankabandi II coordinator Michel Nyabenda said registration into the Registre social unique continues, with 249,671 households already enrolled against a final target of 290,000.

systems.platform: Modernised MIS deployed in the government data centre

facts.fact: President Ndayishimiye highlighted progress made in setting up the registre social unique at the opening of the ninth CNPS general assembly.

The World Bank says investments in a Unified Social Registry and CORE-MIS enable transparent targeting and have established the foundations of Burundi's national social protection system, used to identify over 100,000 flood- and food-crisis-affected households.

The World Bank says Merankabandi's Social Registry is also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project to reach vulnerable households, and that the systems are increasingly used across sectors and by other programmes.

note: Document states nothing on a social registry.
The Unified Social Registry is only envisaged; no procurement, pilot or population stated.
